name: Disable Xbox Game Bar & DVR
description: Disables Xbox Game Bar and DVR capture features to reduce background resource usage.

description_i18n.en: Disables Xbox Game Bar and DVR capture features to reduce background resource usage.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert die Xbox-Spielesteürung und Aufnahmefunktionen, um Hintergrundressourcen zu sparen.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive la barre de jeu et les fonctions d'enregistrement pour réduire l'utilisation des ressources.

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies registry values under HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\GameDVR and HKLM policies to disable GameBar, AppCaptureEnabled, ShowStartupPanel, UseNexusForGameBarEnabled, AllowGameDVR, and Windows Game Recording settings
